definitions.explanation: The perception of sounds, especially voices, when no external auditory stimulus is present. A symptom associated with certain psychiatric conditions, extreme fatigue, or stress.

examples.japanese: {幻聴|げんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧すぎて{幻聴|げんちょう}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I was so tired I thought I was hearing things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幻聴|げんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{聞|き}き{取|と}り→聞き取り：08713_kikitori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The doctor conducted a detailed interview about the patient's auditory hallucination symptoms.

notes:
A compound of {幻|げん} (illusion, phantom) and {聴|ちょう} (hearing, listening). The word is used both in clinical medical contexts and in casual speech to describe hearing sounds that are not there.

In everyday conversation, people sometimes use {幻聴|げんちょう} loosely to express that they thought they heard something that was not actually said, without implying a medical condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幻聴|げんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to hear auditory hallucinations
- {幻聴|げんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧: symptoms of auditory hallucinations
- {幻聴|げんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされる→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧: to be troubled by auditory hallucinations
- {幻聴|げんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: for the hallucinations to stop

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{幻覚|げんかく}→幻覚：17636_genkaku⟧: hallucination (general, including visual)
- {幻視|げんし}: visual hallucination
